headline: PIT @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 5.05 at OAK 4.71, with a projected total of 9.76. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: PIT moved -0.38 runs while OAK moved +1.43, changing the projected margin by -1.81 runs. The projected total climbed +1.05, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: J.T. Ginn has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Shea Langeliers, Henry Bolte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Endy Rodríguez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
